Welcome to The World’s Game. EA SPORTS FC™ 27 launches 25 September. Pre-order now: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/ea-sports-fc-27-ultimate-plus-edition-xbox-one-xbox-series-xs/9PKGXQW57M1R/0017

Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

Pre-order EA SPORTS FC 27™ Ultimate Plus Edition by 31 August.
Receive up to 10,000 FC Points across 5 months, Seasons 1 - 5 of the Premium Pass, and more. EA SPORTS FC 26™ players will also receive a 92+ OVR ICON in EA SPORTS FC™ 26 Football Ultimate Team™ for immediate use and an Evolution that boosts any player’s dribbling Attributes to 99.

#EASPORTSFC #TheWorldsGame #FC27
